Done. `WRK-PLAN-BILL-PRORATA-001` is active with two tasks, both gate-cleared and committed (`ad09a96`), and the plan was **not** executed.

Worth your attention: the Gate A2 red-team found a genuine numeric conflict — `WRK-SPEC-BILL-PRORATA-001`'s "day 15 of a 30-day month charges half the fee" is mathematically incompatible with `DOM-BILL-PRORATA-001`'s own "last day charged one day" criterion (no single day-counting convention satisfies both). The plan resolves this in favor of DOM (higher trust, and it's DOM's own literal example) — day 15 charges 160/300, not 150/300 — and ledgers it as a Knowledge gap in the plan's `## Adversarial Review` section rather than silently picking a number. That WRK-SPEC criterion should get corrected via brainstorming when you have a moment.

The gate also caught and fixed a real floating-point rounding bug (`1.005` misrounding to `1.00` under naive `Math.round`), a timezone footgun in date handling, missing leap-year test coverage, and a self-contradicting test-file edit instruction in the original Task 002 draft — all confirmed with an actual `node --test` run (9/9 passing) before commit.
